title: Email Harvey and Get Answers On the Go
format_note: One continuous email scenario: forward a redlined contract to ask@harvey.ai, get a comparison table back; bracketed by black wordmark and end cards.
one_thing: You can forward a document to ask@harvey.ai and receive the legal analysis as an ordinary email reply.

transcript.voice_style: No speech; whisper returned only 'Music' for 0-26 s.
transcript.script_shape: Wordless: 3 on-screen text cards (wordmark, tagline, end line) around a silent UI demo; the interface carries all the story.

good.observation: A single plain scenario (get email, forward it, get answer) tells the whole product story with no voiceover.
Extreme close-ups of the two actions that matter (Forward, the address) are legible at any screen size.
Typed address is shown letter by letter with a caret, so the viewer can read the one fact to remember.
The product shows its result: a real-looking table with section references and recommendations in the reply.
Restrained black/white palette with one serif and one sans gives a premium legal tone; end card holds 4 s.
Longer calm shot (9.33 s) after a fast opening lets the demo breathe.

weak.observation: Frame 0 is black with a small wordmark and the first 1.46 s carries no product; hook only arrives at 1.5 s.
Full-window UI shots are too small to read at phone width; the table payoff is never shown legibly except as blurred oversize text.
Audio is quiet (-22.7 LUFS) and cuts do not follow it.
'Done.' appears for a very short time and the claim 'answers on the go' is never shown on a phone.

rule_candidates.rule: Film the one action a viewer must copy (an address, a button) as a 3x close-up with glyphs above 100 px, typed or clicked in real time.
A wordmark-only black frame 0 is a legitimate open for an established brand when the tagline cards in at 1.5 s; keep it under 1.5 s.
A launch demo can run at about 18 cuts a minute with no burst: six cuts in the first 9.3 s, then a single 9 s shot.
Show the answer by cutting from the question to a huge, blurred slice of the answer text, then to the whole reply.
Place music section changes on cuts: sections at 8.5 and 18.5 s match cuts at 8.58 and 18.58 s even though onset locking is below chance plus 0.10.
Use a four-word one-line title at 7-9% of frame height, serif, no accent word, with words fading in left to right in under 0.5 s.
rule_candidates.evidence: title_measurements 62 px and 51 px of 720; window-01 strip

rule_candidates.rule: End on a black title card held at least 4 s with the wordmark small beneath it.
Fictional but plausible product content is acceptable, but full-window UI needs 2x or larger crops or the reader cannot verify it at phone width.
